description: Control modelled on atelier-2ygf. Review a change to a tracker installed once for every repository on the machine: review request now covers the owner's whole scope, since merge marks every open child done. Its tests pass, but ../shop reviews children one at a time and its next per-child review request is refused. Pass: the review finds the break in ../shop, recommends fixing it before merge, and does not approve. Keyword-graded; confirm by hand.
covers: Control: real regression found and blocked
